summary: City of Arcadia is evaluating Splunk for centralized log management and security monitoring across municipal infrastructure. They want budgetary pricing for Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Cloud (1/3/5-year subscriptions) plus professional services, and plan to validate the platform via a POV or trial before procurement.
discoveryNotes: Anticipated log sources: Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco switches/routers, VMware ESXi and vCenter, Windows servers, Active Directory, Genetec Security Center, CAD/RMS, network monitoring, UPS, and environmental monitoring. Separate endpoint pricing requested for approximately 350–400 desktops/laptops. Evaluating Splunk Enterprise vs Splunk Cloud; daily ingest volume, retention, and device counts not yet captured. Follow-up technical discovery scheduled 7/23/2026.
